final_verification_run.note: Gates re-verified after hash population; the package does not hash itself (self_hash_recorded=false) so this block is not part of any commitment.

what_an_independent_verifier_must_check: Recompute every artifact hash and compare with ARC01_MANIFEST_V1.json + this package; assert POST_FREEZE_ARTIFACT_DRIFT = 0.
Re-derive the data bindings (authority commit, dataset SHA, three funding partition SHAs, OI dataset SHA, price authority SHA) from the certified authority artifacts and from the raw partition bytes.
Independently re-implement the funding robust-z transform and the OI 24h expansion rule from the spec text only, and diff against src/trading_bot/research/arc01/prereg_reference.py (no shared code).

Adversarially test the PIT contract with its own fixtures: future-mutation invariance, past-eligible mutation detectability, archive-completeness non-retroactivity, inclusive threshold boundary, MAD-zero fail-closed, staleness fail-closed, forward-data guard.
Confirm that PRICE_CONTEXT = NONE is implemented as declared (no price feature reaches the signal), and that price is read only at the entry/exit anchors.
Confirm the funding information window and the funding cashflow window are disjoint for every emitted trade, i.e. no double counting.
Confirm the four controls exist, are deterministic and can never be promoted.
Confirm no economic quantity was observed: ARC01_BACKTESTS = 0, ARC01_EXECUTIONS = 0, ARC01_PERFORMANCE_OBSERVED = false, and that no artifact contains a numeric performance value.
Confirm the kill rule and post-freeze immutability statements are present and non-negotiable.
Confirm the commit contains exactly the frozen artifacts plus tooling and that the worktree is clean afterwards.
open_limitations: Common window starts 2021-12-01 (OI/price bound): the 2020-2021 funding history is outside the evaluated window.
The final ~72h of the common window emits no trades (frozen forward-data guard).
Funding cashflow is charged on the entry notional (frozen O(1e-4) simplification); the mark-price authority is not admitted.
OI authority has documented invalid days; gaps fail closed to NO_SIGNAL, which can only be assessed at discovery and may make INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE a terminal outcome.
PRICE_CONTEXT = NONE narrows the ARU candidate sketch (price-rejection leg removed); documented and justified pre-observation.

The DIRECTION/OI/TIMING/NULL controls detect mis-specification, not every alternative mechanism; the ex-funding-cashflow gate exists because the carry leg is systematically favourable to a contrarian funding entry.
No drawdown gate was pre-specified for ARC-01; drawdown is diagnostic only. This is stated explicitly rather than hidden, and cannot be converted into a gate after the fact.

Binding granularity: the three funding partitions are present in this worktree and their SHA256 IS recomputed by the validator; the reused OI/price partitions live in the shared main data root (data/processed/oi_full_history_v2, data/processed/price_1h_v2) and are therefore bound to their certified manifest records plus the per-asset digests recorded in those manifests. The independent verifier MUST re-hash the OI/price partitions from the shared data root.
